title: AI-assisted Artifact Collaboration Workflow
summary: 2026-09-18 Artifact Collaboration 實驗：驗證 Human/Conversation artifact → Agent processing → GitHub publication，以及 GitHub text/source → Agent rendering → Dropbox delivery area；獨立 working area 完成 lifecycle probe。PDF reading 測試顯示當時 <=5 MiB 可 full extracted-text fetch；95.15 MB PDF 可取得 metadata/preview/temporary link，full fetch 受 5 MiB 限制，無 page-range primitive。Direct binary materialization、autonomous workflow_dispatch 與 rollback/recovery 尚未建立完整驗證。此為日期化研究結果，非現行私人協作授權。
flow: Observed on 2026-09-18: Human/Conversation artifact → Agent processing → Dropbox staging → [COLLAB] Artifact Batch Publish → GitHub; GitHub text/source → Agent rendering → Dropbox delivery area → iOS Files/Preview.
